optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Supply Planning Analyst, Supply Chain Collaboration

professionalSummary.text: Owns the weekly supply plan for an assigned product family and releases purchase schedules to suppliers under own authority.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the draft weekly supply plan and the exception list for the family; the senior planner reviewed the draft and released the purchase schedules to suppliers under her authority.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintains the planning parameters (lead times, safety stock, lot sizes) in the planning system.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained planning parameters for the small-appliance product family in the planning system, updating lead times and safety stock after each supplier review and logging every change with its reason.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Leads the weekly supplier planning call and records decisions and actions.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Took the minutes of the weekly supplier planning call chaired by the senior planner, tracked the actions in the shared log and chased suppliers for confirmations between calls.

skills.text: Coordinates plan changes with production and logistics and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Passed plan changes from production and logistics into the draft plan, flagging the ones that needed the senior planner's decision and recording who decided in the change log.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish that the candidate maintained planning parameters, prepared the draft supply plan, led the supplier planning call, coordinated plan changes, and documented limitations. However, they do not establish that the candidate released purchase schedules under own authority or documented hand-over conditions at the end of each planning week.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate has demonstrated key skills for the role, but some requirements remain unverified.
